_README: Every TAPPaaS version: the revision it names and when it reached each channel (ADR-028 D13). tappaas-train writes this at each boundary and urgent fix; RELEASES.md is rendered from it (tappaas-train releases --render after a hand edit). Dates are UTC days. kind: minor | major (a boundary), patch (an urgent fix, ADR-028 D12), release (made by hand, before the train).

releases.note: the first train boundary; numbered retroactively on 2026-10-02
before the train: tagged and released straight to stable. stable moved on to d796e254 (2.0+466) on 2026-09-18, before versions
